title: Why every developer needs to learn about AI agents right now

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the next big breakthrough in software development is not code, but the systems that write it?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI agents can now auto-generate code, debug in real-time, and even optimize for performance using large language models and reinforcement learning.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if developers don’t understand these systems, they risk creating biased, opaque, or unsafe tools with little accountability.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We’re building explainable AI frameworks and open-sourcing tools to ensure transparency and control at every layer.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where AI agents co-develop with humans, enhancing creativity while upholding ethical standards.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future belongs to developers who can shape AI’s role — not just adapt to it.

video_cue: A developer and an AI agent collaborating on a holographic interface, building a sustainable smart city.
